items.title: Hard-rename every KOALA_* env var to LATTICE_* across code, JSON config, wrapper assets, and hook-contract docs (no koala fallback)
items.context: Eliminate KOALA_* env vars with no fallback: (a) for the 17 vars with a LATTICE_* dual-read twin, delete the `|| process.env.KOALA_X` fallback (e.g. registry.ts:289, cli-validate.ts:7); (b) for the 38 KOALA-only vars, RENAME process.env.KOALA_X -> process.env.LATTICE_X across reads AND setters (incl. bin/lattice-codex.js setters), JSON configs, .Codex/ and .claude/ wrapper assets, and hook-contract docs (docs/guide-hooks.md: KOALA_COMMAND/KOALA_NEW_PHASE/KOALA_OLD_PHASE/KOALA_PHASE/KOALA_STAGE). Do NOT touch LEGACY_KOALA_* path constants in core/lattice-paths.ts (those belong to the deferred .koala path work). After the change `npm run build` must pass.
items.userSees: `npm run build` passes; grepping code/config/wrappers for KOALA_ env names returns nothing.

happy.desc: After CHK-001 changes, run npm run build -> exits 0 with no compilation errors; WHY: proves the rename did not break TypeScript resolution or import paths
grep -rE KOALA_[A-Z] across packages/ bin/ scripts/ .Codex/ .claude/ docs/guide-hooks.md -> returns zero matches; WHY: proves every KOALA_ env read/setter was renamed or fallback-dropped
For each of the 17 dual-read twins, verify source files no longer contain || process.env.KOALA_ on same line -> zero hits; WHY: confirms fallback shims are fully removed not just renamed

For 38 KOALA-only vars spot-check LATTICE_ equivalents exist: grep LATTICE_AGENT LATTICE_ROLE LATTICE_PHASE LATTICE_STORY_ID LATTICE_COMMAND LATTICE_ACTIVITY_SOURCE in source -> each has >= 1 hit; WHY: confirms rename actually landed not just deletion

.claude/hooks/session-brief-reminder.cjs has zero residual KOALA_; WHY: CJS hook files outside TS compilation could silently retain stale env reads
bin/lattice-codex.js setters now use LATTICE_* (grep LATTICE_ACTIVITY_SOURCE -> >= 1); WHY: setters are write side; if only reads renamed the var would never be populated

adversarial.desc: No LATTICE_X ?? KOALA_X or LATTICE_X || KOALA_X dual-read shim left behind anywhere (grep LATTICE_.*KOALA_ on same line -> zero); WHY: lingering shim defeats entire goal of eliminating KOALA_ layer
No half-rename: every file in CHK-001 list contains zero KOALA_[A-Z] env tokens (excluding lattice-paths.ts LEGACY_KOALA_*); WHY: file with both read and setter could have one renamed and one missed
No file outside CHK-001 file list in packages/ or bin/ introduces new KOALA_ reference (scope leak); WHY: merge conflicts or auto-generated files could reintroduce KOALA_ tokens

docs/guide-hooks.md now references LATTICE_COMMAND LATTICE_NEW_PHASE LATTICE_OLD_PHASE LATTICE_PHASE LATTICE_STAGE instead of KOALA_ equivalents -> each LATTICE_ present zero KOALA_; WHY: hook-contract docs are user-facing and stale KOALA_ names would confuse adopters

items.title: Update tests and smoke fixtures that assert KOALA_* env-var names so the suite reflects LATTICE_* only
items.context: The smoke/regression tests that set or assert KOALA_* env names (e.g. runtime-environment-checks, codex-adapter, hook-contract, health, story-owner-lease smokes) must be updated to LATTICE_*. Recorded historical fixtures that legitimately contain KOALA_ as past data are out of scope unless they gate a test. After the change `npm run test:e2e` and the affected `npm run test:*` suites must pass.
items.userSees: `npm run test:e2e` passes and the env-related smoke suites pass with LATTICE_* assertions.

happy.desc: npm run test:e2e exits 0 after all 30 test/smoke files updated to LATTICE_*; WHY: e2e suite is the primary gate proving no test broke from the rename
grep KOALA_[A-Z] across all 30 test files in packages/main/src/tasks/ returns zero matches; WHY: proves every KOALA_ env assertion in tests was updated to LATTICE_

Spot-check key smoke files: runtime-environment-checks codex-adapter hook-contract health story-owner-lease now assert LATTICE_ env names (grep LATTICE_ in each -> >= 1 hit); WHY: these are the core env-contract smokes most likely to catch regression

edge.desc: Historical fixtures or snapshot data files containing KOALA_ as past data are left untouched (out of scope); verify no test file imports or reads from a fixture that still sets process.env.KOALA_ at runtime; WHY: a fixture that sets KOALA_ at runtime would cause a silent test pass masking a broken rename

Verify affected test suites individually pass (not just e2e): npm run test passes for the smoke files that were modified; WHY: e2e might skip certain suites; individual suite runs catch failures e2e might miss

Verify no test file has a commented-out KOALA_ assertion that was disabled instead of properly renamed; pattern: grep for // or /* followed by KOALA_ in test files -> zero; WHY: commenting out instead of renaming hides the problem

adversarial.desc: No test file retains a KOALA_ fallback shim (LATTICE_.*||.*KOALA_ or LATTICE_.*??.*KOALA_ pattern) -> zero; WHY: a dual-read in tests would mask failures in production code that dropped the fallback

No test sets both KOALA_ and LATTICE_ versions of the same var (env double-write); grep for lines setting process.env.KOALA_ anywhere in tasks/ -> zero; WHY: double-write in tests hides that production only reads LATTICE_ now

Run a cross-check: the set of env var names asserted in test files is a subset of the env var names used in production source; no test asserts a LATTICE_ var that does not exist in packages/main/src/; WHY: a typo in rename (e.g. LATTICE_COMMMAND) would pass grep but fail at runtime
Verify no test file was accidentally deleted instead of updated (all 30 files in CHK-002 file list still exist on disk); WHY: deletion masks the rename by removing failing tests entirely
